    "selected_bus_ids": selected_bus_ids,
    "selected_count": selected_count,
    "lowest_bus_ids": lowest_bus_ids,
    "lowest_voltages": lowest_voltages
})

print(f"RESULT_JSON={RESULT_JSON}")
